text: {"standards":[{"code":"W.6.2","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Write the Comparison Paragraph activity, students select details from both texts, analyze tone and mood, and organize them into an explanatory comparison paragraph with a topic sentence, evidence, and a concluding sentence."},{"code":"W.6.4","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Write the Comparison Paragraph activity asks for formal style and transitions, but no activity has students plan for a specific audience or revise and edit their drafts for clarity and coherence beyond the pronoun mini-review."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Lesson's Gather Evidence and Analyze Imagery activities use Chapter 18 (pp. 291-299) and the Aeneid Book 6 excerpt (lines 295-336), matching the texts and pages the Outline names."}}
